summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on adding a new analytics section for 'Transport Hub' to accommodate categories like taxi ranks and general transport areas. This is intended as an alternative or expansion of existing park analytics.

The client, who has multiple facilities (golf club, mall, airport, etc.), requires the ability to view data across various types of locations within one unified reporting structure.

It was noted that integrating this type of multi-facility data may present technical complexities.
decisions: The new analytics section should cover 'Transport Hub' categories (e.g., taxi ranks, transport areas).
action_items: Initiate the request by submitting a ticket to Zhek.
